explain: A faithfulness-style evaluation needs the generated answer and retrieved context. The record is ready for a compatible evaluator but does not call Ragas or claim a real score.
steps: Provide case input, answer, and supporting contexts. || Check required fields before passing the row to a version-pinned metric adapter.
name: metric-inputs

explain: Deterministic assertions complement judged language metrics. This local test checks a required source identity without invoking DeepEval or a judge.
steps: Define a predicate for a stable application invariant. || Assert the fixture meets it before interpreting any semantic metric.
name: assertions-evaluation

explain: A configuration-driven evaluation specifies prompts, a provider, test variables, and assertions. The Echo provider returns its input prompt so this smoke test requires no paid model.
steps: Interpolate the question into the prompt and echo that prompt back. || Assert that the response contains sale, then use a compatible real provider for a separate quality experiment.
expect: The echoed prompt contains sale, so the contains assertion passes with a compatible Promptfoo CLI.
limit: Optional Promptfoo configuration sketch, JSON-parsed only here; execute against your pinned CLI version to verify its schema.
name: promptfoo-config

explain: Link a trace to case feedback and release identity so an evaluation failure can be investigated. The artifact is platform-neutral and does not require a dashboard.
steps: Preserve trace and case identities in the evaluation result. || Join them to the safe operation metadata needed to investigate.
name: trace-feedback

explain: Metric names alone do not establish comparability. Rubric, model, inputs, and implementation versions are part of a score's identity.
steps: Record both score profiles. || Refuse direct equivalence when the judge or rubric differs.
name: metric-comparability

explain: A portable JSON record preserves case, configuration, outcomes, and failures independently of the library UI. Unknown judge results remain null.
steps: Serialize a complete case result. || Parse it again to demonstrate an inspectable export rather than a dashboard-only number.
name: portable-eval

explain: Judge caching includes evaluated content, evidence, rubric, judge, and implementation identities. A changed rubric invalidates a superficially identical answer's old judgment.
steps: Build the full compatibility key. || Compare it after the rubric changes while the answer remains the same.
name: judge-cache-key

explain: An agent evaluation may inspect expected tool use and outcomes as well as final text. This local fixture demonstrates an invariant that an ADK evaluation adapter can consume.
steps: Declare the tool that is required for this task. || Compare actual invocations without demanding unrelated exact text matches.
name: trajectory-evaluator

explain: Context relevance, groundedness, and answer relevance are separate dimensions. A context-relevant answer can still fail support.
steps: Store reviewed values for all three checks. || Identify the failing dimension rather than averaging it away.
name: rag-triad
